seoTitle: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump | Pinjin 66–75 kW 25 m³/h Xingtai
description: The diesel mixer pump is one Xingtai trailer that mixes and pumps: 4108 diesel 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, stone 100 / 300 m, 13 mm 60 / 180 m, 24 mm 40 / 120 m, 4200 kg. It is not the electric mixer pump (45 kW + 14 kW) and not a batching plant.

answerBlock.what: Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump is a diesel integrated concrete mixer pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Catalogue parameters: 4108 diesel 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, stone 100 / 300 m (≤ 1 inch), 13 mm stone 60 / 180 m, 24 mm stone 40 / 120 m, 4100 × 2200 × 3000 mm, 4200 kg. Series note: 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. It does not list a separate 14 kW mixer motor. It is not a batching plant.
answerBlock.who: Sites that mix and pump on one diesel trailer matched to 25 m³/h, 23 MPa and the printed stone-distance pairs, at 4200 kg.
factors: One 66–75 kW diesel versus the electric mixer pump at 45 kW + 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 4500 kg
24 mm stone is 40 / 120 m on this page; do not reuse the electric mixer’s 4 cm cell
Series note names 400 and 500 mixer pairings, not a second hopper
An Alibaba mixer-with-pump listing title is not this 25 m³/h cell

faqs.question: Does the diesel mixer pump list a 14 kW mixer motor?
faqs.answer: No. This page lists one 4108 diesel at 66–75 kW, 25 m³/h, hopper 0.4 m³ and 4200 kg. The electric integrated mixer pump lists 45 kW plus a 14 kW mixer motor, 21 m³/h and 4500 kg. Two product pages.

faqs.question: What mixer size does the diesel mixer pump series note print?
faqs.answer: 30 model with 400 mixer; 40/50 model with 500 mixer. Output on the page is 25 m³/h. The note is the drum pairing, not a second published m³/h.
